questions.q: How many pilgrims joined the Prophet SAW in the Farewell Hajj?
questions.explain: The Prophet's only Hajj, three months before he died.

questions.q: What did the Farewell Sermon abolish regarding riba?
questions.explain: The Farewell Sermon abolished the riba of jahiliyyah.

questions.q: Who faces the severest trials according to the hadith?
questions.explain: Whatever problem we have exists in the life of the Prophet SAW.

questions.q: What small share does change start with according to this lecture?
questions.explain: Of 124,000 companions, only about 300 are said to have joined Badr.

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW do when a Bedouin urinated in the mosque?
options: Held back the companions and advised him gently
questions.explain: Deal with difficult people with wisdom.

questions.q: What distinguished Abu Jahal from believers though all wore robes and turbans?
questions.explain: Look at the essence, not labels or clothes.

options: Parenting that begins with love and trust, then religion
questions.explain: A child must feel most loved before being taught prayer.

questions.q: The companions had no concept of retirement.
questions.explain: True. They maximised their lives for Islam.

questions.q: Age and physical ability are an excuse to stop striving.
questions.explain: False. Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari struggled until almost 90.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The sphere of things we can directly influence
Love of the world and fear of death

questions.explain: Hajjat al-Wada' is the farewell Hajj, wahn is love of the world and fear of death, ghaflah is heedlessness, and the circle of influence is what we can directly affect.

questions.q: Many things worry us. What does the ustaz advise?
options: Focus on our own circle of influence
questions.explain: Do not be busy with too many things.
